summary: Phase 2 (Sage 200 order sync via Simulate) fully verified backend + frontend. Backend pytest: 7/7 pass. UI: login → Service Desk → Inventory & Distribution → Sage Orders → Simulate Sage feed produced exactly 2 mirrors (SO-1001 FR/EUR, SO-1002 US/USD), both in Needs Mapping, health=Warning, cards total=2 & needs-mapping=2. Ran Simulate 6x total → still exactly 2 rows (idempotency proven). Order Exceptions listed FITFR01+USGYM02 and TREAD-900/BIKE-500/ROWER-300/SPARE-BELT (DELIVERY correctly excluded). Mapped FITFR01→AlphaCo (existing CRM company, no duplicate) and mapped TREAD-900+BIKE-500. Retry mapped orders → new Distribution Order DO-000004 with source 'Imported From Sage' and dealer 'Fitness France SARL'. Post-retry Simulate reported Skipped=1, Duplicates Prevented=1, Needs Mapping=1 (SO-1001 skipped, SO-1002 still unmapped). Sage 200 Connection page shows credentials-not-configured banner + capability discovery. Live 'Run sync' with no Sage connection did NOT create/duplicate orders (total stayed at 2). Backend pytest also asserts 5 provisional equipment units on DO for SO-1001 (2 TREAD + 3 BIKE).

issues: Each Simulate run inserts a fresh needs_mapping error even when the SAME order remains unmapped, so the 'Sync errors' list grows with duplicates (7 identical SAGE-1002 rows after 7 runs). Consider upsert-by-(sage_order_id,type) or auto-resolve prior needs_mapping errors when the next run re-classifies the same order. Cosmetic/UX only — doesn't affect idempotency of mirrors/DOs.

action_items: OPTIONAL: dedupe/auto-resolve stale 'needs_mapping' rows in sage_sync_errors so the Order Exceptions → Sync errors card doesn't accumulate identical entries across repeated Simulate runs.

OPTIONAL: OrderExceptions component reads dealer_name from mapping row but for a fresh unmapped account (empty results) the input placeholder search requires >=2 chars — consider seeding q with the CustomerName from the mirror for one-click linking on common cases.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_sage_sync._resolve_dealer does a regex match on company name for auto-linking. Building a regex from an untrusted external value (Sage CustomerName) without escaping is a latent ReDoS risk if a Sage record ever contains regex meta-chars; use re.escape() or an exact-match $eq.

_do_run computes health/telemetry per-run but sage_sync_errors are never cleared on a fresh Simulate run — over time the Order Exceptions → Sync errors card grows without bound. Consider soft-resolving prior needs_mapping errors at run start (or de-dupe by (sage_order_id,type,resolved:false) via upsert).

Retry endpoint blanks the mirror hash to force re-evaluation but does NOT clear the mirror.distribution_order_id — fine because _import_one recomputes, but worth a comment: correctness relies on inv_distribution_orders lookup by sage_order_id being the true idempotency check.
_sample_feed dates are hard-coded; that's exactly what makes repeat Simulate runs byte-identical (idempotency proven). Good design; keep the docstring.

Acceptable per instructions.
